title: Toward the theory on local cohomologies at the ideals given by simplicial posets
summary: For a simplicial poset $P$, Stanley assigned the face ring $A_P$, which is the quotient of the polynomial ring $S:=K[t_x \mid x \in P \setminus \{\widehat{0} \}]$ by the ideal $I_P$. This is a generalization of Stanley-Reisner rings, but $S$ and $A_P$ are not standard graded in this case, and $I_P$ is not a monomial ideal. To establish the foundation of the theory on local cohomology $H_{I_p}^i(S)$ and its injective resolution, we give an explicit description of the graded injective envelope ${}^*\! E_S(S/\mathfrak{p}_x)$, where $\mathfrak{p}_x$is the prime ideal associated with $x \in P$,…
